incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired: inference-service.canary.p99_latency > 1.5s (us-west-2-canary) — triggered 3x in 2m. PD: https://pagerduty.example/incidents/P12345 :rotating_light:
anya: acked — I'm on it, pulling up console and logs now :wave:
incident-bot: PagerDuty escalation to on-call +1 (anya).
jake: seeing the same spike on our internal canary dashboard, looks like tail latency only, no 5xxs so far. link: https://console.redwood/inference/canary/graphs?range=5m
anya: logs show a brief CPU ramp on proxy-01 and a burst of open connections, sample log:
```
2026-03-15T09:12:03Z proxy-01 INFO connections=312 cpu=78% request_ms=162
2026-03-15T09:12:04Z proxy-01 INFO connections=487 cpu=94% request_ms=174
```
anya: autoscaler kicked up new rep on the backend then scaled down immediately. might be autoscale thrash.
maria: any customer-facing errors? checking support queue now.
support: nothing in customer tickets, no SLO breaches in the last 15m.
jake: if it's just canary, low risk. still want to mute noisy PD pages — they cause churn. suggestion: add short suppression window for canary alerts or require sustained duration.
ops_lead: +1 to suppression/hysteresis. also consider bumping min replicas for canary pools to avoid cold spikes.
devops-bot: Silence issued: #incidents channel muted for PD-service:inference-canary for 30 minutes (requested by ops_lead) :white_check_mark:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert auto-resolved at 1900004410 — alert condition returned to normal.
anya: metrics returning to baseline, p99 back under 600ms. no 5xxs, latency burst lasted ~40s.
jake: created follow-up INF-2345 to tune canary thresholds, add 60s sustained window, and increase canary min replicas. assigned to eng-runtime.
ops_lead: assigning follow-up to @jake and @maria for post-incident tuning and writeup.
maria: will check whether the autoscaler policy needs change; will add notes to runbook if we change thresholds.
anya: handing off to morning on-call @maria for follow-up actions, leaving thread pinned. :memo:
maria: ack — I'll pick this up, will coordinate with runtime team in the AM.
anya: closing out this thread for now — no customer impact, transient canary noise, suppress rules + ticket opened. :thumbsup:
